evals.prompt: Draw a UML class diagram of a library: Book, Copy, Member, Loan. Copies belong to a Book. A Loan links a Member to a Copy.
evals.expected_output: Annex A class diagram SVG. Composite aggregation diamond on Book toward Copy. Association ends named with multiplicities only where specified. No crow's-foot. Keywords only from Annex C. Frame kind pkg or class.

evals.prompt: Sequence diagram: a Member calls borrow(copy) on Circulation and gets a loan back.
evals.expected_output: Annex A sequence diagram. Frame heading sd. synchCall filled head, reply dashed open or filled head (17.4.4). Time downward.

evals.prompt: Use case diagram for a library with Member and Borrow copy including Identify member.
evals.expected_output: UseCase ellipses, Actor stick-man outside a subject rectangle. «include» dashed open arrow from Borrow copy to Identify member (18.1.4).
